components.name: acq
components.doc: Run control, sampling and the records of a scope, built from the scope's modules.

components.name: timebase
components.doc: The horizontal system: time per division, the record length rule and the trigger position.

components.name: trigger
components.doc: Edge trigger on its own analog path (instrument-authoring.md 8.4, G5).

components.name: adc
components.doc: The ADC group shared by a scope's channels: resolution, top sample rates and interleaving.

components.name: meas
components.doc: Automatic measurements on a scope's records (instrument-authoring.md 8.4).

components.name: xfer
components.doc: The selected points of a channel's record, encoded as text, an ASCII list or a binary block.

components.name: ch1.inp
components.doc: An electrical input with a resistive (and optional capacitive) impedance to ground.

components.name: ch1.front
components.doc: The vertical channel: coupling, bandwidth, and the scale and offset with their ranges.

components.name: ch1.probe
components.doc: The probe setting of one channel: display volts are the volts at the input times ``ratio``.

components.name: ch1.cal
components.doc: Calibration coefficients keyed by the measurement context, and the calibration ledger.

instrument.name: scope
instrument.label: 示波器
instrument.description: Siglent SDS2104X Plus, 4 channels, 100 MHz, 2 GSa/s. Real model (D42): commands, replies and waveform transfer follow the SDS Series Programming Guide EN11F; ranges follow the data sheet. Settings the manual gives no *RST value for use the SimuBench defaults listed in the coverage table.
